I am using the new drag-and-drop file upload feature of  fileInput. Works great!

There is one minor problem: A user uploads a file, and notes that the file had an error and that she has to upload the modified file #
with the same name again. By default, it will not trigger the change, because the file name is the same. One has to refresh the 
whole page to be able to trigger actions.

I would like to clear the drag/drop field after a successful upload, but could not find somethink like updateFileInput 

Dieter
